meta.purpose: Single normalized catalog for the Gameplay Director LLM: mode selection, primitive vocabulary, parameter truth, and safe generation bounds across ARENA / RUNNER / VERTICAL / RADIAL plus mode transitions. Consolidation only - no gameplay fact was corrected, invented, or flattened.

conflicts kept per-mode and recorded in integration_warnings

not_enforced: NO cross-mechanic coordination (e.g. safe tile vs ring gap alignment)

per_mode.RUNNER: placement_intensity 0..1 (default 0.5) drives R01 height / R02 width / R03 clearance / R08 strength lerps; phrase_intensity > 0.55 adds hazards, composer caps DESCENT/RELEASE loudness at 0.4
per_mode.VERTICAL: spawn lead only: clamp(lerp(base, base*0.65, intensity), max(0.6, minReactionBeats), base)
per_mode.RADIAL: metadata-only for gameplay (telegraph result ignored; raw library telegraph used)

health.pool: single shared pool across modes, max 100 (TUNING.health)
health.continuity: health persists across mode switches (transitions state_handoff.health); death at 0 -> outcome FAILED

per_mode_damage.RUNNER: see modes.RUNNER.catalog.player.damage + safety.damage (contact / fall-out model; head bonk 0)

health.warning: damage semantics differ per mode while the pool is shared (integration_warnings W03)

health_score_combo.score: no point score system in any mode catalog; accuracy = notesHit/(notesHit+notesMissed) where applicable

combo.across_mode_switch: reset by incoming mode activate; preserved on same-mode boundaries

mode_switching.pipeline: mode-agnostic ModeManager.setMode (no mode-id branches in the transition path); 16/16 mode pairs supported
mode_switching.breather_formula: max(6 beats, round(bpm/20)) beats back from the outgoing section end beat; same-mode boundaries get none
mode_switching.what_resets: combo, position/velocity, RUNNER gravity, all active mechanics (on incoming activate); held long-notes cut without penalty
mode_switching.what_persists: health, score/notes counters, invulnerability frames, held keys (global input state)
mode_switching.beat_clock: music never stops; absolute beat continuous; switch point = bar line - leadIn (<= 1 bar; max(4, beatsPerBar) for courses)

best_for: layered spatial pressure from telegraphed hazards (rings, fans, spirals, sweeps)
continuous melody-accented movement: player motion in real seconds, hazards on beat
dodge/graze mastery and perfect-dodge chains (0.5 beat cooldown)
avoid_when: you need jump/platform/gravity verbs (not supported in ARENA)
you need per-note rhythm tap windows (ARENA judges collision/graze, not timing offsets)
you rely on cross-mechanic coordination or concurrency caps (none enforced)
ARENA.timing_resolution: fractional beats + offsetBeats for events; telegraph floor 0.6 beat / 0.9 s comfort reaction
ARENA.safety_summary: per-mechanic floors enforced in code (reaction 0.6 s, gap >= 0.06 field units, gap shift <= 0.85x player speed); no cross-mechanic coordination or concurrent cap - off-runtime tools: fairness-check, camp-audit, level-report

best_for: Geometry-Dash-style manual jump/slide/gravity-flip timing over authored terrain
phrase archetypes (staircases, gap chains, sky steps, flip set pieces) synced to strong beats and 8th-note streams
speed-feel sections whose arcs stay tempo-invariant in beats
avoid_when: gravity flips closer than 2 beats (no runtime clamp)
difficulty-driven scaling (section difficulty is METADATA ONLY for RUNNER)
RUNNER.timing_resolution: fractional beats for events; jump envelope in beats (full jump 0.95 air-beats); reaction window 3 beats = 180/BPM s (1.2 s @150)
RUNNER.safety_summary: physics-derived bounds (max gap 0.2106 u single / 0.2445 double / 0.2971 pad 1.35; step <= 0.27 u; landing >= 0.104 u); runner-check 25/25 patterns + 15/15 courses clearable off-runtime

best_for: note-chart rhythm on 6 fixed lanes: tap streams, alternating lanes, chords, holds
call-and-response and trill shapes at 1-beat lane intervals
avoid_when: drift/path holds (V04 drift subsystem is dead code; path data collapses to first lane)
VERTICAL.timing_resolution: arbitrary fractional beats + offsetBeats/stepBeats; fixed windows 0.09/0.16/0.25 beats; approach fixed 2 beats
VERTICAL.safety_summary: no runtime chart-feasibility guarantee; runtime chord clamp 6 (recommended 2); hold >= 0.5 beat; lapse tolerance 0.12 beat (regrab allowed)

best_for: rising/falling melody contours as clockwise/counter rings
short chords <= 4 scoreable targets with independent per-direction judgement
avoid_when: hold notes (unsupported: no mechanic emits holdBeats > 0)
same-beat adjacent cardinal pairs (alias into diagonals, unplayable)
RADIAL.timing_resolution: arbitrary fractional beats + offsetBeats/stepBeats; fixed 2-beat approach; windows 0.09/0.16/0.25 beats
RADIAL.safety_summary: no runtime guards (no overlap/duplicate/min-spacing checks); recommended same-direction interval 0.5 beat, chords <= 2; one D02 event dedupes to <= 8 directions

primitives: ACTION_JUMP Player jump (single, variable height, buffered, coyote)
ACTION_AIR_JUMP Player double jump (mid-air second press)
D02 Opposite Double (legacy name: accepts ANY direction chord)
D06 Clockwise (legacy name: sequence is fully data-driven, any order)

integration_warnings.summary: Mechanic/note timing is in beats everywhere, but player-facing motion units differ: ARENA player movement is real seconds (0.62 u/s, BPM-independent); RUNNER physics is seconds with beat-domain arcs (0.26 u/beat scroll); VERTICAL/RADIAL approach is a fixed 2-beat function. No unified motion unit exists.
integration_warnings.resolution: per-mode values preserved; director must consult the owning mode before converting time to distance

integration_warnings.summary: Identical window values 0.09/0.16/0.25 beats appear in VERTICAL and RADIAL as rhythm tap judgement windows; ARENA and RUNNER have no tap windows at all (ARENA judges by collision/graze with perfect-dodge cooldown 0.5 beat; RUNNER judges by physics contact). Same numbers, different gameplay meaning.
integration_warnings.resolution: kept per-mode; do not present 0.09/0.16/0.25 as a global judgement contract

integration_warnings.summary: Health pool is shared across modes (max 100) but damage rules differ per mode: ARENA damage table MISS 8 / COLLISION 10 / PROJECTILE 12 / OBSTACLE 15 with 0.8 s invulnerability; VERTICAL and RADIAL MISS -8 that bypasses invulnerability; RUNNER uses its own contact/fall-out damage model (catalog.player.damage).
integration_warnings.resolution: per-mode damage values preserved; cross-mode HP continuity means mode order changes the difficulty budget

integration_warnings.summary: section.difficulty (1..5) shares one tier mapping (1 EASY / 2 MEDIUM / 3 HARD / 4-5 INTENSE, unset MEDIUM) but its runtime effect differs per mode: ARENA telegraph tiers (real), VERTICAL spawn-lead only, RADIAL ambient-only (mechanics never read it), RUNNER METADATA ONLY.
integration_warnings.resolution: per-mode effect statements preserved in global_contract.difficulty_model

integration_warnings.summary: placement intensity has a real per-mechanic effect in ARENA (telegraph/travel scaling) and RUNNER (R01/R02/R03/R08 lerps, phrase thresholds), but is spawn-lead-only in VERTICAL and gameplay-metadata-only in RADIAL.
integration_warnings.resolution: per-mode intensity model preserved in global_contract.intensity_model

integration_warnings.summary: ARENA A10 variant FOLLOW_GAP behaves identically to BASIC_GAP (RingMechanic buildRings switch), and A14/A15 are phantom references existing only in mechanics.mvp.json compatibility metadata.
integration_warnings.resolution: original values kept; generation must not emit FOLLOW_GAP as a distinct capability nor reference A14/A15

integration_warnings.summary: VERTICAL drift/path subsystem is unreachable: V04 degrades to a straight hold; note path data in VP06/VP07/VP09 collapses to the first lane; drift lapse tolerance 0.18 beat, drift checkpoints and drift SFX have no producer. The parsed V04 path parameter is discarded.
integration_warnings.resolution: kept as-is with degraded status; directors must not design drift charts

integration_warnings.summary: constraints.maxSimultaneousThreats and requiresMechanics are metadata only (never read at runtime); section/pattern function labels (including the 2 function:"TRANSITION" patterns) and musicTags/playerSkills/compatibility are likewise unconsumed.
integration_warnings.resolution: flagged; runtime concurrency is uncapped (except transition pending queue 64), so stacking safety is author responsibility

integration_warnings.summary: RUNNER R02 clamp ceiling 0.22 u EXCEEDS the max single-jump gap 0.2106 u at default speed: authored gap width param >= ~1.5 produces unjumpable gaps.
integration_warnings.resolution: kept as-is (no code change); autogenerators must cap authored gaps at 0.21 u

integration_warnings.summary: Same-mode section boundaries get NO runtime breather; held keys carry across the switch and are reinterpreted by the incoming mode immediately; pending-queue buffering silently drops spawns beyond 64 per mode; hazards stay lethal until the switch beat (breather suppresses creation, not existing hazards).
DUO is declared in the mode enum with a PlaceholderMode fallback but has no reachable runtime gameplay from shipped content.
integration_warnings.resolution: UNKNOWN capability preserved as placeholder; do not generate DUO sections

integration_warnings.summary: Chord caps differ and are not unifiable: VERTICAL silently clamps chords >6 and collapses duplicate lanes (recommended max 2, min same-lane interval 1 beat); RADIAL chords are uncapped in code but a single instant can score at most 4 targets (diagonals) and same-beat adjacent-cardinal pairs alias into diagonals (recommended max 2).
integration_warnings.resolution: per-mode bounds preserved in each mode normalized block and director_view.safe_generation_summary

integration_warnings.summary: No unified playability guarantee exists: ARENA enforces per-mechanic floors but no cross-mechanic coordination or concurrency cap; VERTICAL/RADIAL have no runtime chart-feasibility guard; RUNNER clearability is verified off-runtime (tools/runner-check.ts, fairness tools are ARENA-scoped); transition safety depends on compiler discipline.
integration_warnings.resolution: kept; generation pipelines must run the per-mode off-runtime checkers

integration_warnings.summary: No point score system exists in VERTICAL/RADIAL (notesHit/combo/ACC only); ARENA and RUNNER catalogs likewise expose no score model; combo resets on mode switch (preserved on same-mode boundaries). Score-based director logic has no runtime backing.
integration_warnings.resolution: recorded as a global fact in global_contract.health_score_combo
